claims.claim: B declined the invitation to join A and others at the concert this evening
claims.adjudication_reason: 'Why not?' presupposes B expressed a negative response or refusal to the invitation; 'declined' is a reasonable reading of this presupposition, though the exact firmness is uncertain.

claims.claim: B was invited to join a group going to a concert this evening
claims.attribute: B received an invitation to a concert this evening
claims.adjudication_reason: Explicitly stated in Turn 1: 'Will you join us?' directly shows B was invited to join a group going to a concert this evening.

claims.claim: B is not currently part of the group ('us') going to the concert
claims.attribute: B is not among those already going to the concert

evidence.quote: We are going to the concert this evening . Will you join us ?

claims.adjudication_reason: 'Will you join us?' presupposes B is not currently part of 'us'; one cannot be asked to join a group one already belongs to.
